title: Google Maps Lead Generation & Contact Scraper

searchQueries.title: Search queries
searchQueries.description: What to look for, e.g. 'dentist', 'coffee shop', 'law firm'. Each query is run across the location you set below. A location is required when you use queries.

areaName.title: Location - named area
areaName.description: Easiest way to set a location: a built-in city or country, e.g. 'jakarta', 'bali', 'singapore', 'london', 'new york', 'indonesia'. For anywhere else, use a centre point with a radius, or a bounding box.

centerLatitude.title: Location - centre latitude
centerLatitude.description: Latitude of the centre point. Use with centre longitude and radius.

radiusKm.title: Location - radius (km)
radiusKm.description: Search this many kilometres around the centre point. Results are also filtered to this exact radius using each lead's real coordinates.

boundingBox.title: Location - bounding box [south, west, north, east]
boundingBox.description: Most precise option. The box is tiled into multiple search points for coverage, then results are filtered to the box using each lead's real coordinates.

tileSizeKm.title: Search tile size (km)
tileSizeKm.description: How far apart the search points are placed inside your area. Smaller = more thorough and more requests. Leave empty to pick automatically from the area size.

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Stop each query after this many unique businesses. Google returns 20 per request.

placeUrls.title: Specific Google Maps URLs
placeUrls.description: Optional. Scrape named businesses directly instead of (or as well as) searching. Paste Google Maps URLs; short links are followed automatically.

placeIds.title: Specific Place IDs / CIDs / feature IDs
placeIds.description: Optional. Accepts a Place ID (ChIJ...), a numeric CID, or a raw feature ID (0x...:0x...).

enrichFromWebsite.title: Enrich from the business website
enrichFromWebsite.description: Visit each lead's website and extract email addresses and social media accounts. This is what makes the leads outreach-ready - Google never exposes an email.

followContactPage.title: Follow the contact page
followContactPage.description: When a homepage has no email, follow one same-domain contact/about link and try there. One extra request per lead, only when needed.

enrichmentConcurrency.title: Enrichment concurrency
enrichmentConcurrency.description: How many business websites to fetch at once.

fetchPlaceDetails.title: Fetch full place details
fetchPlaceDetails.description: Google returns two richnesses of record and chooses by client; the Apify platform usually gets the reduced one, which has no review count and only today's opening hours. Switch this on to fetch each lead's detail page: it reliably recovers review counts, review URLs and descriptions. The full 7-day schedule often cannot be recovered from a datacenter IP at all - check openingHoursComplete on each lead. Costs one extra request per lead.

requirePhone.title: Only keep leads with a phone number
requirePhone.description: Drop businesses with no phone number. Useful when your outreach is cold-calling rather than email.

requireWebsite.title: Only keep leads with a website
requireWebsite.description: Drop businesses with no website. Also the ones enrichment can actually find an email for, so pair it with enrichment.

requireEmail.title: Only keep leads with an email address
requireEmail.description: Applied after enrichment. Needs 'Enrich from the business website' switched on, otherwise nothing has an email and every lead is dropped.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only keep businesses rated at or above this, e.g. 4.0. Leave empty for no rating filter.

exportFormats.title: Extra export files
exportFormats.description: Also write the leads to the key-value store in these formats. The Apify dataset is always produced regardless.

language.title: Language (hl)
language.description: Google interface language. Affects category names and opening-hours wording.

region.title: Region (gl)
region.description: Two-letter country code biasing Google's results, e.g. US, ID, GB. Set this to the country you are targeting.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Off by default, and that is the recommended setting: these Google endpoints have no WAF, so the platform's own IP works and costs nothing. Enable a proxy only to spread load across IPs at high volume, and leave the group list empty so Apify picks a group your plan has. RESIDENTIAL is NOT recommended for Google - it is commonly answered with a consent or CAPTCHA interstitial, which makes searches return nothing.
